entities.name: Seitaro Yamazaki
entities.description: Legendary samurai of Kamigawa, twin of Shujiro, who slew the ice-and-fire kami that was his father.

entities.name: Shujiro Yamazaki
entities.description: Legendary samurai twin of Seitaro, wounded by Sharp-Ear.

entities.name: Lord Konda
entities.description: Lord the brothers served until the Kami War.

entities.name: Godo
entities.description: Barbarian lord and fierce opponent of Konda whom the brothers served as lieutenants.

entities.name: Yamazaki father
entities.description: Father of the brothers who guarded the village as a kami guardian and died in the fight.

entities.name: Sugi Hayashi
entities.description: Site of an attack by Godo's bandits.

events.summary: Konda pulls forces from the Sokenzan Range, dooming the brothers' home villages; disgusted, they leave his service.
events.quote: Disgusted, they left Konda's service and returned to the Sokenzan.

events.summary: The brothers join Godo's sanzoku bandits as his most respected lieutenants.
events.quote: The brothers joined the sanzoku bandits and became Godo's most respected lieutenants.

events.summary: At Sugi Hayashi, Shujiro nearly kills Nagao and is shot through the neck by Sharp-Ear.
events.quote: was shot through the neck by Sharp-Ear in response

events.summary: After a failed assault on Eiganjo, the brothers leave Godo to answer their father's note.
events.quote: it was after a failed assault on Eiganjo that they left Godo's service as well

events.summary: Seitaro slays a kami of ice and fire, which proves to be their father; he dies from the fight.
events.quote: Their father died as a result of the fight

events.summary: The brothers become guardians of the village, which never falls.
events.quote: the village never fell throughout the war or after because of them

relations.quote: They were twin brothers identical in appearance.

relations.note: trained in his service until the Kami War
relations.quote: trained in the service of lord Konda

relations.note: slew the kami that was their father in guardian guise
relations.quote: It was after Seitaro had slain the kami
Godo was a fierce warrior who opposed Konda
